title: Quarterly Cohort Roadmap: Private Instance Compatibility & Escalation Playbook
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Objective: Define a quarterly roadmap and operational playbook to enable staggered cohort activations for Private/VPC/on-prem customers. The doc coordinates compatibility gating (OS/container/runtime), upgrade rollouts, escalation paths, and OKR signals so that Platform, Eng, and Customer Success can reliably onboard 8–12 enterprise tenants with minimal downtime and clear rollback criteria.
milestones: M2: Upgrade/rollback runbook & canary gating defined - 2026-03-01
M3: Automation scripts for preflight checks (k8s manifests + health probes) - 2026-03-22
M4: First pilot cohort activation (3 tenants) + metrics baseline - 2026-04-05
M5: Post-pilot retro and Q2 activation schedule published - 2026-04-15
acceptance_criteria: Complete compatibility matrix with test ownership and pass/fail criteria for each platform variant
Automated preflight checks return green for >90% of pilot tenants without manual remediation
Canary upgrade executes without service-impact incidents in pilot cohort (SLO variance <5%)
Escalation playbook validated with CS + SRE and communicated to customers
OKR: Enable 8 tenant activations with documented runbooks and <2 critical incidents
metrics: Post-activation 7-day error rate (target < 0.5% increase from baseline)
Mean time to remediate (MTTR) for activation-related incidents (target < 4 hours)
Customer activation satisfaction (CSAT) survey after pilot (target >= 4/5)
rollout_plan: Staged cohorts: 1) Lighthouse tenants (3) for tight oversight, 2) Early adopters (5) with limited automation, 3) Broad activation. Each cohort uses the same preflight checklist and automated probes; SRE on-call shadowed during all activations. Rollout blocked on green signal from compatibility tests and security review. Communication: pre-activation email + runbook link + scheduled workshop with customer engineering.
risks: HW/driver incompatibilities in customer environments -> mitigation: expanded kernel/container testing matrix and guest tooling
Large config drift across tenants -> mitigation: enforce constrained manifest templates and automatic diff alerts
Insufficient observability for private instances -> mitigation: scoped console retention increase for pilot and explicit tracing hooks
Escalation handoff unclear between CS and SRE -> mitigation: joint playbook session and pager duties defined
